name: Asahina Shin
source: A homeless girl living in a tent near the beach, who left her home due to family issues. She supports herself by working in a part time job day and night to the point that she ends up really tired in class and sometimes even skips school because of it. Shin's curse is “Gluttony” obviously. Just hearing the word meal makes her want to eat anything and everything at full throttle.
